summary: Comprehensive testing of CollerMind AC Rental System. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases pass covering auth (cookies, bcrypt, brute-force protection headers), public tariffs/tracking/access control, admin RBAC + CRUD, settings persistence, rental submission validation (durasi/consent/date/hunian/no-NIK), and E2E order regression (contract signed, invoice Rp1.306.000, Jakarta Selatan region, 10+ status_history entries). Frontend: /sewa 8-step form works end-to-end, all 8 step labels shown, no NIK field, durasi limited to 3/6/12/24, consent required, review shows Estimasi total Rp848.000 (not 'bayar sekarang'), shadcn calendar used. Tracking /tracking: masked name in summary, wrong kontak → 403 with error toast, correct kontak unlocks full access showing contract signed badge, invoice Rp1.306.000 and rekening Jakarta Selatan; no Stripe/checkout UI anywhere.

minor.issue: Admin tariffs collection contains duplicate 'Kapasitas=1 PK, Variant=Standart' rows (one at Rp248.000 aktif=true, another at Rp300.000 likely inactive) plus legacy 1.5/2/3 PK Standart entries. Public list filters aktif so users unaffected, but admin UI will show inconsistent duplicates. Suggest deduping and hiding/removing legacy tariffs from admin listing.

action_items: (Optional) Cleanup duplicate/legacy tariffs in /api/admin/tariffs listing so admins only see the three approved CollerMind tariffs (0.5 PK Standart 198k, 1 PK Standart 248k, 0.5 PK Inverter 248k).
critical_code_review_comments: core.py hitung_extra_pipa uses math.ceil((total_pipa - 3)); if total_pipa is a float like 3.4 this rounds up to 1m extra (charging Rp130k) which may or may not be desired — confirm rounding rule with product (spec example was 5m → 2m extra, which matches).

routes_public.py submit_rental: rate-limit uses request.client.host which behind ingress may resolve to a proxy IP shared across users, potentially throttling legitimate submissions. Consider using X-Forwarded-For.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ rental order created during backend pytest submit test (TEST_regression@example.com). Otherwise no persistent test data added.

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py provides a regression suite. Note there is a public /api/public/rentals submit rate limit (5/hr per IP); the suite consumes exactly 1 slot per full run (only the success test submits). If you re-run within an hour multiple times, the submit test may 429.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking issues found. Only minor data hygiene concern: multiple 1 PK Standart tariff docs exist in Mongo (one at 248k active, others legacy 300k/1.5 PK etc). Public consumer view correctly shows only aktif tariffs, so behaviour matches spec; admin UX may look confusing.
